title: R5-D4
description: Captured by Jawas in the desert climes of Tatooine, R5-D4 almost ended up in the service of the Lars family before his motivator blew. Instead, he somehow managed to end up in the service of the Rebellion with Carson Teva before making his way back to Tatooine where Peli Motto put him to work in her chop shop. A shy and timid Droid, he got traded away to the Mandalorian and was instrumental in helping him test the atmosphere of the planet to see if it was truly as dead as the rumors said.
